about_short_description.short_description: Waymark is a company dedicated to improving access and quality of care for people receiving Medicaid.

product.name: Community-Based Medicaid Care Services
product.description: Care coordination for Medicaid members addressing medical, behavioral health, medication, and social needs through community health workers, care coordinators, pharmacists, and licensed counselors.

product.name: Waymark Signal Suite
product.description: Predictive analytics that identifies rising-risk Medicaid members, estimates when acute events may occur, and prioritizes patients and interventions for care-team outreach.

product.name: Waymark Compass
product.description: A physician-supervised AI platform that gives care teams predictive insights and supports patient engagement between visits to address health risks before they escalate.
